verdict.rationale: The product is a single logo-design Agent Skill. Its tooling covers logo auditing, test sheets, boards and favicon export. The only packaging-related item is a script that packages this skill itself (package_skill.py), which is adjacent and not a meta-skill that guides an agent through writing, improving or packaging new skills. No skill-authoring guidance is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
